packets.responsibility: Lead-in (1769-1770, 2 lines): 'Smooth noise in -1..1 for a 1D or 2D input — unlike random(), nearby inputs give nearby results, which is what makes it usable as motion.' exprNoise(x,y) (1771-1778): `_exprTick()` (budget check); reads `_ectx`, returns 0 if absent (outside any expression evaluation); if `x` is an array (a caller passed a single `[x,y]` argument instead of two), destructures it (`y=x[1]; x=x[0]`) BEFORE the `y===undefined` branch, so `noise([1,2])` and `noise(1,2)` are equivalent call forms; 1D path when `y` is still undefined after that: `hashNoise1D(ctx.seed+7717, _num(x))*2-1`; 2D path otherwise: `hashNoise2D(ctx.seed+7717, _num(x), _num(y))*2-1`.
